verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's first-party developer docs describe V3 webhooks configured as webhook subscriptions. They deliver HTTP callbacks when significant account events occur, including event types for incident priority and responder changes. Incident Workflows can also send custom webhook POSTs. Missing for 10: evidence on delivery guarantees, retries and signature verification; a full event-type catalog and filter scoping; independent or hands-on corroboration.
